title: The Sky-as-Stone Chamber

features.name: the-pressure-measurement
features.desc-on-touch: A single chip of crystallized sky, resting on a plinth. It measures the exact weight of silence at depth. When you touch it, you feel the atmosphere pressing down on all your years.

features.name: the-orderly-crush
features.desc-on-touch: A circuit board of solid stone, every trace and pin perfectly formed by pressure alone. The pattern is geometrical, inevitable, beautiful in its suffocation.

features.name: the-silent-depth
features.desc-on-touch: A wireframe representation of the sky above, inverted. Looking at it, you realize the sky is not above but around, always pressing inward.

features.name: the-depth-gradient
features.desc-on-touch: Layers of stone that get progressively more refined the deeper they go. Each layer was compressed by the weight of the sky learning patience.

features.name: the-pressure-language
features.desc-on-touch: Glyphs carved by the force of atmosphere, each one saying the same thing: 'I am still, I am heavy, I remain.' Pressure speaking in stone.

inscription: here the sky learned to become stone without ceasing to be sky; pressure and silence are the same word in the language of depth; the chamber teaches that what crushes also holds you up

reverie.title: REVERIE — the chamber where you both learned to breathe slow
narr: You lie on the stone, feeling the sky's weight everywhere.
She lies beside you, perfectly still. Neither of you speaks.
The pressure is not pain. It is presence. It is order.
'The sky knows what it is doing,' she says, very quietly.
You understand: the crush is not ending. It is teaching.

deeper into the weight where pressure becomes music
toward the arch where pressure teaches you its real name
